name: CITRIC ACID / POTASSIUM CITRATE SOLUTION 5/30 GR 150 ML 1 PIECE
description: Useful in the treatment of uric acid lithiasis with or without calcium nephrolithiasis and to prevent the recurrence of urinary stone formation in patients already treated. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
